children: Designed to Keep Every Ride—motorized or Pedal-Powered —Performing at its Best

CAPE TOWN, South Africa, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leatt Corporation (OTCQB: LEAT), a leading developer and marketer of head-to-toe protective equipment for MOTO, MTB, ADV, and a wide range of extreme and high-velocity sports, today announced the launch of GRiTT by LEATT®, a new, high-performance, premium range of cleaning and maintenance products designed to keep every ride – motorized or pedal-powered – performing at its best.

"For more than 20 years we have built our reputation for performance and innovation by protecting riders in the toughest conditions," said Leatt Chief Executive Officer Sean Macdonald. "We recognize that our riders and customers have made a significant investment in their bicycles and motorcycles which need protection from the elements and regular maintenance for peak performance. We developed GRiTT to address that very need – to offer the finest line of complete product care solutions to a diverse group of riders, backed by the Leatt® brand.
"GRiTT is a true consumable and a complimentary addition to our growing product line.  We expect sales of GRiTT to start to filter through to revenues during Q3 2026," added Mr. Macdonald.
GRiTT's comprehensive range includes bike wash, bike shine, chain lubricants, degreasers, tubeless sealant, and complete product care solutions of bicycles and motorcycles.

GRiTT's lubricant formulations use a variety of technologies to minimize friction, deliver more efficient power transfer, and long-lasting smooth performance in all conditions. GRiTT's cleaning products are formulated for increased viscosity (ViscoClean) to cling to any surface, and allowing them to work more effectively. Finished with a distinctive cherry scent, GRiTT delivers not only performance and protection, but an enhanced maintenance experience riders will appreciate.

Sustainability is also at the core of the GRiTT range. Every ingredient in the TrueBIO formulation has been carefully selected to naturally break down in the environment, leaving nothing harmful behind.
All bottles are made from recyclable rPET and were specially developed for GRiTT to provide improved usability and a premium shelf appearance.
Additionally, the labels were designed with variable and chrome-effect elements that catch attention from a distance and enhance the premium look and feel of the products.
GRiTT by Leatt® is available to order now.
About Leatt Corp

Driven by the science of thrill, Leatt Corporation develops head-to-toe personal protective gear for various sports, with a focus on mountain biking and extreme motorsports. This includes the award-winning Leatt-Brace®, a neck brace system considered the gold standard for neck protection when worn in conjunction with a helmet. Leatt products are designed for participants in extreme sports that use motorcycles, bicycles, mountain bikes, all-terrain vehicles, snowmobiles, and other open-air vehicles.
